subject: Request: duplicate charge on INV-202609 — proposed credit and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@emeraldpharma.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Billing Ops <finance-ops@emeraldpharma.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T08:12:00+00:00
Subject: Overcharge on INV-202609 — need correction

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well. We were reviewing our September invoices and noticed that INV-202609 (dated 2026-09-30) appears to include a duplicate line for the dedicated capacity hours on Sep 24–30. The invoice total shows €28,740 but our internal ledger indicates the correct amount should have been €16,400.

I’ve attached our copy of INV-202609 and a spreadsheet showing the two line items we think were doubled. Can you confirm whether this was a billing upload issue on your side and advise next steps? We need a credit memo or refund and VAT treatment confirmation (Emerald is VAT-registered in IE: VAT IE1234567).

We’re close to month-end and would prefer a credit applied to our November invoice rather than a wire refund if that’s possible. PO: EM-PO-7789.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Director, Finance Operations
Emerald Therapeutics
attachments: INV-202609.pdf, invoice_lines.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@emeraldpharma.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Overcharge on INV-202609 — need correction

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear note and the spreadsheet. I’m sorry for the trouble; I’ve flagged this to finance and billing. 

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I’ll put Sean (your account exec) on to coordinate with Emerald on acceptance of the remedial approach.
- Laura in Billing will prepare either a credit memo or refund paperwork depending on your preference (credit on next invoice vs bank refund).
- We’ll include VAT handling notes: if Emerald wants a credit on a future invoice we can reflect the correction as a negative line with the corresponding VAT treatment (we’ll follow EU reverse-charge mechanics if applicable).

Preliminarily, we can apply a goodwill/service credit for the portion attributable to the duplicate charge (approx €12,340) to expedite reconciliation while the formal credit memo is processed. That will keep your ledger tidy for month-end.

Could you confirm: 1) you’re ok with a credit applied to your Nov invoice, and 2) confirm Emerald’s VAT registration number (you provided IE1234567 — correct?), and 3) whether you need a bank refund instead?

I’ve attached the billing team’s checklist and will loop Laura for timelines.

Best,
Hannah
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: billing_checklist.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@emeraldpharma.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-07T11:18:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Overcharge on INV-202609 — need correction

Hi Alex / team — I’m on this. Thank you for the invoice and the breakdown — that made it straightforward to validate.

What we will do:
1) Issue a formal credit memo for €12,340 to correct the duplicate line. Draft attached (credit_memo_draft.pdf).
2) Because Emerald is VAT-registered in the EU, we will issue the credit with VAT treatment matching the original invoice. Where reverse-charge applies we will include the standard reverse-charge note and set VAT at 0% on the credit memo — you’ll be able to reclaim as appropriate on your side.
3) Timeline: we can have the draft credit memo finalized and posted to your account ledger within 5 business days. If you want the value as a bank refund instead of a credit note, please complete and return the refund_request_form.pdf; refunds take an additional 7–10 business days after approvals.

Required from Emerald to complete this:
- Confirm VAT ID (full legal company name and VAT number)
- Confirmation of preference: credit on next invoice or bank refund (and bank details if refund)
- Copy of PO EM-PO-7789 (if you’d like us to reference it on the memo)

Links for approvals: DocuSign envelope (https://redwood.docusign.com/envelope/ABC-EM-091) — signing the credit acceptance will accelerate processing. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://hubspot.example/contacts/emerald-therapeutics/12345

Laura Bennett
Senior Billing Specialist
Redwood Inference
attachments: credit_memo_draft.pdf, refund_request_form.pdf
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@emeraldpharma.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-07T13:42:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Overcharge on INV-202609 — need correction

Thanks Laura — that timeline works. 

To confirm: Emerald Therapeutics Ltd — VAT IE1234567 — PO EM-PO-7789. We prefer a credit applied to our November invoice rather than a wire refund (simpler for our treasury team). I’ve reviewed the draft credit memo and it looks fine; I will complete the DocuSign this afternoon.

One additional ask: can the credit memo include a short narrative line referencing the duplicated usage line and the original invoice number? Our auditors want a clear audit trail.

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-08T16:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Overcharge on INV-202609 — need correction

Alex — thanks for the confirmation and for signing the DocuSign. We’ll proceed with the credit-on-next-invoice approach. Final notes for the record: 

- Credit amount: €12,340 (matches the duplicated line correction).
- Credit memo will reference INV-202609 and call out the duplicated usage line per your audit request.
- VAT handling: we will issue the credit memo with a reverse-charge note and VAT set to 0% on the credit itself (you can claim per local rules).
- Timeline: draft finalized and posted within 5 business days; credit will appear on your account and be available to offset the November invoice.

Laura will send the finalized credit memo once posted; Sean will follow up on the commercial side to confirm we’ve captured any downstream usage impacts. Let me know if anything changes or if you decide you’d prefer a bank refund and we’ll switch to the refund workflow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on your side — will mark this resolved after the credit posts.

Cheers,
Hannah
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
